rationale.reason: The manned powered aeroplane is admitted only with independently evidenced unladen weight at or below 2000 kg; the equality boundary belongs here.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

Manufacture of a new complete manned fixed-wing single spark-ignition reciprocating piston-propeller aeroplane with sheet-aluminium wing and metallic fuselage structure, including declared steel-tube portions, actual cut/form/drill/rivet and qualified joining, supplied powerplant integration, fixed tricycle landing gear, flight-control/interior/electrical installation and bounded manufacturing acceptance. Riveting and tube joining follow actual released drawings; no particular alloy or joining technique is imposed on every product. Classification applicability requires independently established unladen weight not exceeding2000kg. This narrower route does not cover every aircraft in CPC49622.

Exclude unmanned aircraft, helicopters/rotorcraft, unpowered or powered gliders, turbine/turboshaft/turbofan propulsion, electric/hybrid propulsion, primarily composite airframes, kits, separately sold engines/parts/propellers, repairs/overhauls and air transport service. Exclude training/commercial flight, passenger-km, routine maintenance, airports and end of life. Actual factory acceptance flight belongs to declared manufacturing endpoints only, with measured attributable support inputs and release compartments; no lifetime or complete cradle-to-gate claim follows.

unresolved_flow_identities.reason: Steel Pipe generic record does not establish chromium-molybdenum aviation tube grade and released supply; other candidates aluminium/titanium or pile column.
Public generic rivet reference Volume does not identify solid versus bulk volume or precise aluminium aviation rivet. No same-part physical conversion established; do not relabel property Mass.
Industrial Maintenance Coatings collective identity does not establish one aircraft primer formulation.

unresolved_flow_identities.selected_flow: Finished fixed tricycle aircraft landing-gear assembly
unresolved_flow_identities.reason: Initial and refined candidates semi-trailer landing gear/fishing gear, not actual fixed tricycle aircraft main/nose assembly. Identity unresolved; no database-absence claim.

Refined PMMA candidates beads and processing intermediates, not finished shaped aircraft windshield; monomer elementary exchanges cannot substitute. Identity unresolved.

unresolved_flow_identities.reason: Refined candidates whole aircraft/ground trainers, generic aircraft inputs and chair components, not one completed aircraft seat/restraint. No forced component-group identity.
Bounded radio/navigation searches return radioactive species and general avionics/aircraft input groups; these do not establish one supplied VHF communication radio.
Lead Acid Battery candidate Mass but public classification17100 electrical energy conflicts with physical product; no forced adoption.

Bounded aviation oil queries return engines/fuel/waste oil; no matching supplied actual formulated aircraft lubricating oil grade established. Waste/product and contained engine prefill cannot substitute.

Refined ethylene-glycol results include elementary releases and neat chemical, not supplied aqueous formulated coolant with actual concentration/aircraft qualification. Keep actual formulation identity gap.
